about: Azariah's address continues. He recites the food laws of Leviticus 11 and Deuteronomy 14: the clean animals that chew the cud and part the hoof, the unclean beasts, the fish with fins and scales, the unclean birds and swarming creatures, and the rule that touching a carcass makes one unclean until evening. He tells the people to keep these laws, so as to be blessed in the land God gave them for the sake of Zion, and then turns to the queen. He praises her wisdom, which he puts second only to Solomon's: she tore down idols, cleansed her people, and was named Makeda, ‘not so’, for the things she rejected. He closes with a long praise of Wisdom as mother, treasure, healer and light, all from God, and says that Zion has come to Ethiopia by God's will, to guide, as I read it, Menelik, called David.

sentences.l: Ox sheep and-kid(?) ḥärge(?) stag and-ibex(?) wild-ox(?) dəskən(?) and-wəʿela(?) ʿarga(?) and-zərat(?) and-every beast which-cloven hoof-his and-claw-his eat and-which-chews-cud eat;
sentences.i: Oxen, sheep, the kid or gazelle, the ḥärge (?), the stag, the ibex (?), the wild ox (?), the dəskən (?), the wəʿela (?), the ʿarga (?) and the zərat (?), and every beast whose hoof and claw are cloven: eat; and whatever chews the cud: eat.
sentences.n: Read this as a list: the ወ- falls between groups, not on every name. ላህም ‘ox/cattle’ and በግዕ ‘sheep’ are sure; ጠሊ ‘kid, gazelle’ and ሀየል ‘stag’ are good Geʿez words. The next names correspond to the list of clean wild animals in Deuteronomy 14:4-5, which has about ten names, and I cannot match them one by one with confidence: ሐርጌ is unknown (an antelope or a kid, ?), ይጠል (ወይጠል, taken here as ወ- ‘and’ + a word for ‘ibex’, since this list joins its groups with ወ-; ch. 25-26 took the ወ as part of the word, ?), ቶራ (cf. ቶር ‘wild ox’, ቶራት in ch. 35, and ch. 25-26, where it was left as ‘wild ox or antelope’, ?), ድስክነ (resembling Hebrew dishon, ?), ውዕላ (ወ- + ወዕል ‘ibex, wild goat’, ?; ibex already stands for ይጠል, so I keep this one untranslated), ዓርጋ and ዝራት (perhaps the giraffe, Hebrew zemer, ?) are all uncertain, and the translations are guesses. ዘንፉቅ ሰኰናሁ ወጽፈሪሁ ‘whose hoof and claw is cloven’ (ዘ- + ንፉቅ ‘cloven, split’ + ‘his’) is the rule of Leviticus 11:3. ብልዑ is the 2mp imperative ‘eat!’. ዘይትመሰኳዕ is ዘ- + 3ms imperfect of ተመሰኰዐ ‘chew the cud’ (tä-stem), the other half of the rule: both signs together make an animal clean.

sentences.n: ወዝንቱሰ is ወ- + ዝንቱ + the contrastive enclitic -ሰ ‘but as for this’. ኢትበልዑ (negative + imperfect) is the plain prohibition. The line follows Leviticus 11:4-6 (camel, coney, hare) and Deuteronomy 14:7. ገመል is the camel. ዳሲጳዳ looks like Greek dasypous ‘rough-foot’, the Septuagint's word for the hare (?); ካርግልዮን probably reflects Greek choirogryllios, the Septuagint's rendering of the Hebrew shafan, the coney or hyrax (?). Both are transliterated from Greek, and the identifications are not certain. ይትመሰኵዑ is the plural of the verb in the last unit; ጽፈሪሆሙ ‘their claws’ (suffix -ሆሙ, 3mp).

sentences.n: The unclean birds of Leviticus 11:13-19 and Deuteronomy 14:12-18. Many of the names are Greek words of the Septuagint list, written in Geʿez letters, and several are known only from this list, so the identifications are uncertain: ንስር is the eagle; ግሪጳ is Greek gryps ‘griffon vulture’ and ጊጳ perhaps gyps ‘vulture’ (?); ኤልያጣን may come from Greek haliaetos ‘sea eagle’ (?); ቋዕ is the raven; ግላውቃ is Greek glaux ‘owl’; ለሮን is Greek laros ‘gull’; አሮድዮን is Greek erodios ‘heron’; ኢብን is Greek ibis; ቀጣራቃጤን is Greek katarraktes ‘cormorant or gull’ (?); ክራድዮን is Greek charadrios ‘plover’; ጳርፋርዮና is Greek porphyrion ‘purple gallinule’ (?); ሂጳጳ may be epops ‘hoopoe’ (?). Left unidentified: ሆባይ, ሰገኖ, ቃቃኖን (possibly kyknos ‘swan’ or kokkyx ‘cuckoo’, ?), ጒዛ, ጒጓ, ወኣባጒንባሕ (possibly ‘father of …’, ?), ጽግነት. ወዘአምሳሊሁ is ወ- + ዘ- + አምሳል ‘likeness’ + -ሁ, ‘and what is like it’, Leviticus' ‘after its kind’; ዘርኵስ is ዘ- ‘of’ + ርኵስ, ‘of uncleanness’, a predicate: ‘these are of uncleanness’.

sentences.i: Of whatever creeps along on two, four or six feet: it is unclean. Do not eat their flesh, and do not touch their carcasses; whoever touches their carcasses is unclean until evening.
sentences.n: ዘይሰርር is ዘ- + 3ms imperfect of ሰረረ, which I take as ‘creep, move along’ (?). The distributive በበ፪ is በበ- ‘by, each’ + the numeral, ‘by twos’ (and so በበ፬ ‘by fours’, ወበበ፮ ‘by sixes’); እግሩ ‘its feet’ gives the manner. Numerals are shown in Ethiopic digits. The rule on touching a carcass is that of Leviticus 11:24-28 (‘unclean until evening’). ኢትግስሱ is a prohibition, ‘do not touch’ (ገሰሰ); ወዘገሰሰ is ወ- + ዘ- + 3ms perfect, ‘and whoever touched’. በድን ‘carcass’.

sentences.i: We have told you this so that you may keep it and practise the fear of God, and so be blessed in this land of yours, which God gave you for the sake of heavenly Zion, the ark of God's law, for you were chosen on her account.
sentences.n: Azariah's own comment on the food law. ዘንተኬ is ዘንተ ‘this’ (accusative) + the emphatic -ኬ ‘indeed, now’. ነገርናክሙ is ነገረ ‘tell’, 1cp perfect + -ክሙ ‘you (pl)’. ከመ introduces purpose, and ትዕቀቡ ወትግበሩ are subjunctive 2mp (‘that you keep and do’); ፍርሀተ እግዚኣብሔር is ‘fear of God’, in the construct state (ፍርሀተ ‘fear-of’) and also object of ‘do’. ትትባረኩ is the tä-stem of ባረከ, ‘be blessed’. ጽዮን ሰማያዊት ታቦተ ሕጉ is the Zion theology: Zion is the ark (ታቦት), here called ‘heavenly’ (I take it that the book means the heavenly original of which the Ark is the earthly copy, ?); the construct ታቦተ ‘ark-of’ governs ሕጉ ‘his law’, and ለእግዚኣብሔር repeats the owner (‘of God’), the doubling Geʿez likes. ተኀረይክሙ is the passive of ኀረየ ‘choose’, 2mp perfect.

sentences.n: ወአበዊነሰ is ወ- ‘and/but’ + አበው ‘fathers’ (plural of አብ) + -ነ ‘our’ + the contrastive -ሰ: ‘but our fathers’, the Israelites at Jerusalem, as I take it. ተመነኑ is a 3mp perfect I cannot place with confidence: perhaps ‘they were rejected, scorned’ (?), the sense of ተመነነ in chs. 21-22 and 60a. ዘነሥኦሙ is ዘ- ‘what’ + ነሥአ ‘take’ + -ሙ ‘them’; by በእንተ ዘ- ‘because’; whether ‘took from them’ or ‘took them’ is not clear (?). ትዕቀብክሙ is 3fs imperfect of ዐቀበ ‘keep’ + -ክሙ ‘you’, the subject being feminine ጽዮን; ለክሙ ወለዘርእክሙ ‘for you and your seed’ repeats the object with ለ-, and ለዓለም ‘for ever’ (lit. ‘to the age’). The promise recalls Genesis 17:7.

sentences.i: May he bless the fruit of your land, multiply your cattle, and keep your children in everything in which you put your trust (?). And you also, my lady: your wisdom is good, surpassing the wisdom of men; there is no one like you, and no one who matches your mind. It is not the counsel of women, but (that of) whatever has been created until now (?); rather, the knowledge of your heart goes beyond even the counsel of men; and none equals you in the abundance of your knowledge except Solomon, my lord;
sentences.n: The first three verbs (ወይባርክ, ወያብዝኅ, ወይዕቀብ) are 3ms jussive, ‘let him bless, multiply, keep’, with God as subject, so a blessing rather than a statement. ዘትትመሐፀኑ is ዘ- + tä-stem 2mp imperfect of መሐፀነ, which I read as ‘entrust yourselves, take refuge’ (?). Azariah then turns to the queen: ወአንቲኒ ‘and you also’ (-ኒ emphatic), እግዝእትየ ‘my lady’. ዘተዐደወ እምጥበበ ሰብእ is ዘ- + 3ms perfect ‘surpassed’ + እም ‘than’; ጥበበ is the construct of ጥበብ ‘wisdom-of’. ዘከማኪ is ዘ- + ከማ ‘like’ + -ኪ ‘you (fs)’, and አልቦ ‘there is not’ opens both ‘none like you’ and ‘nothing that resembles’; ዘይትማሰላ ለኅሊናኪ is ዘ- + the 3ms imperfect ይትማሰል of the tä-ma stem of መሰለ ‘be like’, with the object suffix -ኣ ‘it’ (ል + ኣ is written ላ) anticipating ለኅሊናኪ: ‘who resembles it, your mind’, the same doubling as ወደሳ ለንግሥት in ch. 90; the verb takes -ኪ ‘you’ in the same way in ዘይትማሰለኪ below. ባሕቱ ‘but’ here is awkward; I read አኮ ምክረ አንስት ባሕቱ ዘተፈጥረ እስከ ይእዜ as ‘not (only) women's counsel, but (that of) whatever was created up to now’ (?), the point being that her mind outdoes all counsel; ‘nor of anything created’ I rejected, because ባሕቱ is not ‘nor’. ፈድፈደ ‘exceeds’. በብዝኀ is በ- + the construct ብዝኀ ‘abundance-of’. Solomon is the single exception (compare ch. 90, where the exception is ‘my lord the king’). This unit has about forty words, under the usual limit and with no ፤ inside to cut at.

sentences.i: Your wisdom surpasses even Solomon's, so that you drew in the sons of the host of Israel and the ark of God's law with the cords of your knowledge. You tore down the house of their idols, destroyed their images, and cleansed uncleanness from your people, for you removed from them what God hated. For your name also God prepared it, who named you Makeda; and its interpretation is: ‘not so’.
sentences.n: ወእምሰሎሞንኒ is ወ- + እም ‘than’ + ሰሎሞን + -ኒ ‘also, even’. ተዐደወ ‘surpassed’ takes ጥበብኪ ‘your wisdom’ as subject. ትስሕቢ is 2fs imperfect of ሰሐበ ‘draw, drag’; ደቂቀ ኀይለ እስራኤል is a double construct, ‘sons of host of Israel’ (‘the Israelite host’). በአሕባለ አእምሮትኪ is በ- ‘by’ + አሕባል ‘cords’ (plural of ሐብል) in the construct + ‘knowledge’ + -ኪ: ‘by the cords of your knowledge’, an image of leading by cords, as in Hosea 11:4 (?). ነሠትኪ ‘you tore down’, ደምሰስኪ ‘you destroyed’, አንጻሕኪ ‘you cleansed’ (causative), አሰሰልኪ ‘you removed’ are all 2fs perfect (-ኪ). Source slip: ወደምሰስኪ አ ፡ ምሳሊሆሙ prints አ and ምሳሊሆሙ as two words; it is አምሳሊሆሙ ‘their likenesses’ (images), kept as printed. ዘጸልአ is ዘ- + ጸልአ ‘hate’; እምላዕሌሆሙ ‘from upon them’. ወለስምኪኒ is ወ- + ለ- + ስም ‘name’ + -ኪ + -ኒ ‘and for your name also’, and አስተዳለዎ ‘he prepared it’ with ዎ for ‘it’. The explanation of the name: ማክዳ is glossed ‘not so’ (አኮ ከመዝ), and the phrase ትርጒምናሁ (‘its interpretation’, ትርጒም + a suffix of ‘it’, ?) leads into the series that follows, in which she says ‘not so’ to each of her people's practices. ብሂል is the verbal noun of ይቤ, ‘saying’, here ‘that is’.

sentences.i: You looked at what God does not approve among your people, and you said, ‘This is not good; rather it is right that we worship God.’
sentences.n: ነጸርኪ is 2fs perfect of ነጸረ ‘look’. ዘኢይሠምር is ዘ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect of ሠምረ ‘be pleased with’. ትቤሊ is the 2fs of the defective ይቤ ‘say’ (the -ሊ is its ending; the glossary notes this), and the unit opens a series of six refusals the queen made: አኮ ከመዝ ሠናይ ‘it is not thus good’, አላ ‘but’, ይረትዕ ‘it is right’ (3ms, impersonal), ንስግድ ‘let us worship’ (1cp subjunctive). The pattern repeats through the next five units; I note it once.

sentences.l: Understanding and-knowledge and-beginning-of wisdom-indeed fear-of God and-knowledge and-counselling(?) good-also almsgiving and-mercy until for-ever which exists(?); this all you-found my-lady with God-of Israel holy-of holies, knower-of hearts who-searches what-in heart-of man, from-with-him all was;
sentences.i: Understanding and knowledge, and as for the beginning of wisdom, the fear of God and knowledge, and also giving good counsel (?), almsgiving and mercy for ever, which exists (?): all this you found, my lady, with the God of Israel, the Holy of Holies, the knower of hearts, who searches what is in the heart of man, from whom everything came.
sentences.n: This is a heavy run of nouns. ቀዳሜ ጥበብሰ is the construct ቀዳሜ ‘beginning-of’ + ጥበብ + the contrastive -ሰ; the saying is the old one, ‘the fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom’ (Proverbs 1:7, 9:10; Psalm 111:10; Sirach 1:14), with ፈሪሀ ‘fear-of’ in the construct. መኪረ is the accusative verbal noun ‘counselling’ and ሠናይኒ ‘good, also’; ምጽዋት ‘almsgiving’, ምሕረት ‘mercy’. እንተ ትሄሉ is the fem. relative with a 3fs imperfect of ሀሎ ‘be, exist’, ‘which exists’; what it refers to is unclear, so I read it as modifying ‘mercy’ (?). ቅዱሰ ቅዱሳን ‘Holy of Holies’ (construct, a superlative), ማእመሬ አልባብ ‘knower of hearts’ (agent noun, construct; compare Acts 1:24, 15:8 and Jeremiah 17:10), ዘየሐትት ‘who searches’ (ሐተተ ‘inquire, examine’; Psalm 7:9). ዘእምኀቤሁ ኵሉ ኮነ ‘from whom everything was’ echoes John 1:3 and Romans 11:36.

sentences.l: And-which-also was by-will-of God was: that she-come Zion into this land-of Ethiopia, and-that she-be-to-him guide for-king-our David, lover-of God, attendant-her for-tent-his, steward-her for-dwelling-of glory-his. ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.i: And whatever has come about has come about by the will of God: that Zion should come into this land of Ethiopia and be a guide to our king David, the lover of God, the attendant of his tent, the steward of the dwelling-place of his glory.
sentences.n: ወዘኒ ኮነ is ወ- + ዘ- + -ኒ ‘and whatever (also)’; በፈቃደ is በ- + the construct ፈቃደ ‘will-of’. ትምጻእ is 3fs subjunctive (‘that she come’), with ጽዮን as the subject and ዛቲ ብሔረ ኢትዮጵያ ‘this land of Ethiopia’ (ብሔር ‘land’ in the construct). ወከመ ትኩኖ is ወ- + ከመ ‘that’ + 3fs subjunctive of ኮነ + -ኖ ‘to him’; መርሐ ‘guide’ is its predicate. ‘Our king David’ is, I take it, the Ethiopian king Menelik, who in this book receives the throne-name David (?), not the biblical David, though the title ‘lover of God’ fits the psalmist as well. መፍቀሬ ‘lover-of’ (construct) and the next two titles, ቀዋሚሃ ‘attendant’ (‘one who stands’; -ሃ anticipates the feminine ደብተራ ‘tent’, as in ch. 25-26, so `i` leaves ‘her’ out) and መጋቢሃ ‘steward’ (-ሃ again anticipating the noun that follows, or else Zion, ?), are appositions to David. The ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ is the usual close of a part and stays attached to this last unit.

glossary.ቅዱሰ: ቅዱስ — holy one (noun/adjective, construct 'holy one of', in ቅዱሰ እስራኤል) · in ቅዱሰ ቅዱሳን 'Holy of Holies' (construct, superlative)
glossary.ቅዱሳን: ቅዱስ — holy ones, holies (plural ቅዱሳን; ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን 'Holy of Holies')
glossary.በቅዱሰ: ቅዱስ — in the Holy One of (በ- 'in' + noun, construct ቅዱሰ)
glossary.በበ፪: በበ — by twos, two each (distributive በበ- 'by, each' + numeral ፪, spoken ክልኤቱ kəlʾetu 'two')
glossary.በበ፬: በበ — by fours, four each (distributive በበ- 'by, each' + numeral ፬, spoken አርባዕቱ arbaʿtu 'four')
glossary.በብዝኀ: ብዝኀ — in the multitude of (በ- + construct 'multitude of', from ብዝኀ)
glossary.በአሕባለ: ሐብል — with cords of (በ- + plural አሕባል, construct)
glossary.በአዕዋፍ: ዖፍ — by birds (በ- 'by' + plural አዕዋፍ of ዖፍ 'bird')
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
glossary.በእንቲአሃ: በእንተ — for her, on her account (preposition በእንተ with 3fs suffix -ሃ, stem በእንቲአ-)
glossary.በከ: በ — by you (በ- 'by, in' + -ከ '2ms you'); sense uncertain (?) · the first part of በከመ 'according as', printed as two words በከ ፡ መ (source slip)
glossary.በፈቃደ: ፈቃድ — by the will of (በ- 'by' + noun, construct 'will of')
glossary.በፈጣሪ: ፈጣሪ — in the Creator (በ- 'in' + agent noun of ፈጠረ 'create')
glossary.ባሕቱ: ባሕቱ — but, however, nevertheless (conjunction; አላ ባሕቱ 'but nevertheless')
glossary.ቤተ: ቤት — house (noun, construct state 'house-of') · accusative 'the house' as object of a verb (የኀድጋ ቤተ 'they leave the house')
glossary.ብሂል: ብሂል — saying, meaning, 'that is' (verbal noun of ብህለ)
glossary.ብሔረ: ብሔር — land, region (construct 'land of') · accusative 'a land' (ርሑቀ ብሔረ 'far, a land'; the construct reading is the alternative (?))
glossary.ተመነኑ: ተመነነ — they were rejected, scorned (?) (3mp perfect, tä-stem; sense as in chs. 21-22 and 60a, from context) (?)
glossary.ተመንደብኪ: ተመንደበ — you were afflicted (?) (2fs perfect, tä-stem; from the root of ምንዱብ 'wretched') (?)
glossary.ተባዕትኒ: ተባዕት — men also (noun 'male, man' + enclitic -ኒ 'also, even')
glossary.ተኀረይክሙ: ተኀርየ — you were chosen (2mp perfect, tä-stem passive of ኀረየ)
glossary.ተአምኖ: ተአመነ — believing, belief (verbal noun/infinitive of ተአመነ)
glossary.ተወከልኪያ: ተወከለ — you trusted her (2fs perfect, tä-stem + -ያ '3fs her')
glossary.ተወክሎ: ተወከለ — trusting, trust (verbal noun/infinitive of ተወከለ)
glossary.ተዐደወ: ተዐደወ — he transgressed, overstepped (3ms perfect, tä-ʿädäwä) · it surpassed (ወእምሰሎሞንኒ ተዐደወ ጥበብኪ 'your wisdom surpassed even Solomon')
glossary.ተጠይሮ: ተጠይሮ — ? (?) unknown, first item in the list of hated things · augury (?), reading omens, verbal noun (ተጠይሮ በአዕዋፍ 'augury by birds')
glossary.ተጸወንኪያ: ተጸወነ — you took shelter in her (?) (2fs perfect, tä-stem of ጸወነ 'shelter, protect' (ch. 24; ተጸወነ 'hid', ch. 81) + -ያ '3fs her') (?)
glossary.ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
glossary.ትሄሉ: ሀሎ — she exists, is (3fs imperfect, h-l-w)
glossary.ትምጻእ: መጽአ — that you come (2ms subjunctive, G, m-ṣ-ʾ) · that she come (3fs subjunctive; subject ጽዮን)
glossary.ትስሕቢ: ሰሐበ — you draw, lead (2fs imperfect/subjunctive, G, s-ḥ-b)
glossary.ትቤሊ: ይቤ — you (fs) say, have said (2fs of defective ይቤ, ትቤሊ; the -ሊ is the 2fs ending, not '1cs to me') (?)
glossary.ትትባረኩ: ተባረከ — that you be blessed (2mp subjunctive, tä-stem passive of ባረከ)
glossary.ትኩኖ: ኮነ — that she be to him (3fs subjunctive + -ኖ '3ms to him')
glossary.ትዕቀቡ: ዐቀበ — keep, guard (2mp subjunctive, G stem; after ከመ)
glossary.ትዕቀብክሙ: ዐቀበ — she will keep you (3fs imperfect + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ቶራ: ቶር — wild ox, or an antelope (noun ቶር 'wild ox, bull', cf. ቶራት in ch. 35; ቶራ with a final -ኣ, accusative or collective (?)); sense uncertain (?)
glossary.ኀሠሥኪያ: ኀሠሠ — you sought her (2fs perfect, G + -ያ '3fs her')
glossary.ኀረይኪያ: ኀረየ — you chose her (2fs perfect, G + -ያ '3fs her'; said to the Queen)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
glossary.ኀይለ: ኀይል — strength (noun, accusative ኀይለ) · construct 'host of' (ኀይለ ሰማይ 'host of heaven') · 'power' (ትገብሩ ኀይለ ከማየ 'you do power like me') · construct 'power of' (ኀይለ ጸላኢ 'the power of the enemy')
glossary.ነገርናክሙ: ነገረ — we told you (1cp perfect + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ነጸርኪ: ነጸረ — you looked (2fs perfect, G, n-ṣ-r; said to the Queen)
glossary.ንስግድ: ሰገደ — we worship, let us worship (1cp subjunctive/imperfect, s-g-d)
glossary.አ: አ — [ʾa], question particle (?) (written detached from the verb) · not a question particle in አ ጥፋእከ (ch. 60): the detached first syllable of አጥፋእከ (አጥፍአ 'you destroyed'), whose rest is written as the next word ጥፋእከ · in ወደምሰስኪ አ ፡ ምሳሊሆሙ the detached first syllable of አምሳሊሆሙ 'their likenesses', not a question particle (source slip)
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አሮድዮን: አሮድዮን — heron, a Greek word in Geʿez letters (erodios) (noun, name of a bird)
glossary.አሰሰልኪ: አሰሰለ — you removed, took away (?) (2fs perfect; perhaps the ʾa-stem of ሰሰለ 'loosen, lighten' (chs. 24, 61) rather than a quadriliteral) (?)
glossary.አስምኮ: አሰመከ — leaning on, relying (?) (verbal noun of the ʾa-stem አሰመከ beside ሰምከ 'lean', as ኣሰምክ in ch. 24) (?)
glossary.አስተቃስሞ: አስተቃስሞ — seeking divination (?) (verbal noun, perhaps of the ʾastä- stem of ቀሰመ 'divine'; cf. መቃስም 'diviners', ch. 60b) (?)
glossary.አስተዳለዎ: አስተዳለወ — he prepared it (3ms perfect, ʾastä- stem + -ዎ '3ms it')
glossary.አቃጣን: አቃጣን — name of a locust-like creature, perhaps from Greek attakes (noun) (?)
glossary.አኀዝኪያ: አኀዘ — you held her (2fs perfect + -ያ '3fs her')
glossary.አንበጣ: አንበጣ — locust (noun; collective, accusative after the numeral)
glossary.አእምሮ: አእምሮ — knowledge, understanding (noun; verbal noun of አእመረ)
glossary.አእምሮትኪ: አእምሮ — your knowledge (noun, stem አእምሮት- + -ኪ '2fs your')
glossary.አፍቀርኪያ: አፍቀረ — you loved her (2fs perfect + -ያ '3fs her'; a verb formed from ፍቅር 'love')
glossary.አፍዮማክን: አፍዮማክን — name of a locust kind, perhaps from Greek ophiomachēs 'snake-fighter' (noun) (?)
glossary.ኢብን: ኢብን — ibis, a Greek word in Geʿez letters (noun, name of a bird)
glossary.ኢትብልዑ: በልዐ — do not eat (ኢ- 'not' + 2mp jussive, prohibition, G, b-l-ʿ)
glossary.ኢትግስሱ: ገሰሰ — do not touch (ኢ- 'not' + 2mp jussive, prohibition, G, g-s-s)
glossary.ኤልያጣን: ኤልያጣን — name of an unclean bird, perhaps the sea eagle, from Greek haliaetos (noun) (?)
glossary.እመ: እመ — if (conjunction) · whether (ጐንደይኩ እመ ትገብእ 'I waited whether she would return') · in case, perhaps (እመ ይሁበከ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'perhaps God may give you offspring') · mother (እም, accusative, predicate: ወኮነተኪ እመ 'and she became a mother to you')
glossary.እምላዕሌሆሙ: ላዕለ — from upon them (እም- 'from' + preposition ላዕለ, stem ላዕሌ- + -ሆሙ '3mp them')
glossary.እምሕዝብኪ: ሕዝብ — from your people (እም- 'from' + noun + -ኪ '2fs your')
glossary.እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')
glossary.እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel')
glossary.እምክረ: ምክር — than the counsel of (እም- 'than' + noun, construct)
glossary.እምኵሉ: ኵሉ — out of all, from all (እም- 'from' + ኵሉ) · more than all (እምኵሉ with አፍቀረተኪ 'she loved you more than all')
glossary.እምጥበበ: ጥበብ — than the wisdom of (እም- 'than, from' + noun, construct ጥበበ)
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እንስሳክሙ: እንስሳ — your cattle, beasts (እንስሳ, collective noun + -ክሙ 'your', 2mp)
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?)
glossary.እግሩ: እግር — his, its feet (noun, stem እግሪ- + -ሁ '3ms his, its'; collective singular 'foot')
glossary.እግዚእየ: እግዚእ — my lord (noun + -የ '1cs my') · vocative 'my lord' (ብቊዐኒ እግዚእየ) · in apposition, 'David, my lord' (አቡየ ዳዊት እግዚእየ)
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ክንፈ: ክንፍ — wing (noun, accusative) · fin (ክንፍ 'wing, fin'; ክንፈ ወቅሣረ 'fin and scale')
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two') · 3ms form before a plural subject (ኮነ መዋዕሊሁ ፷ 'his days were sixty'); 'there was' (ኮነ ረኃብ 'there was a famine') · 'it was' of time (ሶበ ኮነ ጊዜ ድራር 'when it was time for supper'); ወኮነ ፀዋገ 'he became (grim)'
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ወሀበክሙ: ወሀበ — he gave you (3ms perfect + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ወለስምኪኒ: ስም — and for your name also (ወ- 'and' + ለ- 'for' + noun + -ኪ '2fs your' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወለአዕዋም: አዕዋም — and to trees (?) (ወ- + ለ- + plural noun; the singular is not known, taken as 'trees' from the phrase 'stones and trees') (?)
glossary.ወለዘርእክሙ: ዘርእ — and to your seed (ወ- 'and' + ለ- 'to, for' + noun + -ክሙ '2mp your')
glossary.ወሐራዊያ: ሐራዊያ — and harawiya, unidentified word, apparently a beast paired with ዝእብ (ወ- 'and' + noun) (?)
glossary.ወሐቀፈተኪ: ሐቀፈ — and she embraced you (ወ- 'and' + 3fs perfect ሐቀፈት + -ኪ '2fs you')
glossary.ወመኪረ: መከረ — and counselling (?) (ወ- 'and' + a noun, accusative, formed from መከረ 'counsel'; the form is not the usual ምክር, and 'counsellor' is possible) (?)
glossary.ወርኩስ: ርኩስ — and unclean (ወ- 'and' + adjective, masc. sg.)
glossary.ወቀዳሜ: ቀዳሚ — and the beginning of (ወ- 'and' + noun 'beginning, first', construct ቀዳሜ)
glossary.ወበበ፮: በበ — and by sixes, six each (ወ- 'and' + distributive በበ- 'by, each' + numeral ፮, spoken ስድስቱ sədstu 'six')
glossary.ወበድኖሙ: በድን — and their carcass (ወ- 'and' + noun + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ወታቦተ: ታቦት — and the Ark (ወ- + noun, fem.; construct 'ark of')
glossary.ወትርጒምናሁ: ትርጒም — and its interpretation, meaning (ወ- 'and' + noun + -ናሁ '3ms its') (?)
glossary.ወትቤሊ: ይቤ — and you say (ወ- 'and' + 2fs of the defective ይቤ, ትቤሊ; the -ሊ is the 2fs ending, said to the Queen)
glossary.ወትግበሩ: ገብረ — and do (ወ- 'and' + 2mp jussive, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ወነሠትኪ: ነሠተ — and you tore down, took away (ወ- 'and' + 2fs perfect, G, n-ś-t; ነሠተ 'take away, seize' in earlier parts)
glossary.ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
glossary.ወአርወየተኪ: አርወየ — and she gave you drink (ወ- 'and' + 3fs perfect አርወየት, ʾa-stem causative of ረወየ + -ኪ '2fs you')
glossary.ወአስምዐተኪ: አስምዐ — and she made you hear (ወ- 'and' + 3fs perfect አስምዐት, ʾa-stem causative of ሰምዐ + -ኪ '2fs you')
glossary.ወአስተፍሥሐተኪ: አስተፍሥሐ — and she made you rejoice (ወ- 'and' + 3fs perfect አስተፍሥሐት, ʾastä- stem + -ኪ '2fs you')
glossary.ወአበዊነሰ: አብ — but our fathers (ወ- 'and, but' + plural አበው, stem አበዊ- + -ነ '1cp our' + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወአብርሀተኪ: አብርሀ — and she made you shine (ወ- 'and' + 3fs perfect አብርሀት, ʾa-stem causative of በርሀ + -ኪ '2fs you')
glossary.ወአንቲኒ: አንቲ — and you also (ወ- + 2fs independent pronoun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወአንጻሕኪ: አንጽሐ — and you cleansed (ወ- 'and' + 2fs perfect, ʾa-stem causative of ንጽሐ 'be clean')
glossary.ወአእምሮ: አእምሮ — and knowledge (ወ- + verbal noun of አእመረ)
glossary.ወአጥዐየተኪ: አጥዐየ — and she made you sweet (ወ- 'and' + 3fs perfect, ʾa-stem causative of ጥዕየ + -ኪ '2fs you'); sense of the figure uncertain (?)
glossary.ወአጽገበተኪ: አጽገበ — and she satisfied you (ወ- 'and' + 3fs perfect አጽገበት, ʾa-stem causative + -ኪ '2fs you')
glossary.ወአፍቀረተኪ: አፍቀረ — and she loved you (ወ- 'and' + 3fs perfect አፍቀረት + -ኪ '2fs you')
glossary.ወኢተኀድገኪ: ኀደገ — and she does not leave you (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3fs imperfect spelled ተ- for ት-, as ተሐቅፈኒ in ch. 24, + -ኪ '2fs you'); `i` puts it in the past to match the clauses around it
glossary.ወኢኮነ: ኮነ — and was/is not (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ወኢይትመሰኵዑ: ተመሰኰዐ — and they do not chew the cud (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + 3mp imperfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወኣባጒንባሕ: ኣባጒንባሕ — and abagwənbah, name of an unclean bird, unidentified, perhaps 'father of ...' (ወ- 'and' + noun) (?)
glossary.ወእምሰሎሞንኒ: ሰሎሞን — and than Solomon also (ወ- 'and' + እም- 'than' + proper name + enclitic -ኒ 'also, even')
glossary.ወእምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ; ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this') · 'and like' before a noun (ወከመ ድምፀ አንበሳ 'and like the voice of a lion')
glossary.ወካርግልዮን: ካርግልዮን — and the coney, hyrax, a Greek word in Geʿez letters, perhaps from choirogryllios (ወ- 'and' + noun) (?)
glossary.ወክራድዮን: ክራድዮን — and plover, a Greek word in Geʿez letters (charadrios) (ወ- 'and' + noun, name of a bird)
glossary.ወኮነተኪ: ኮነ — and she became to you (ወ- 'and' + 3fs perfect ኮነት + -ኪ '2fs to you')
glossary.ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
glossary.ወውዕላ: ወዕል — and ibex, wild goat (ወ- 'and' + noun ወዕል with a final -ኣ, accusative or collective (?); the written ውዕላ has the two ወ run together) (?)
glossary.ወዘኒ: ዘ — and whatever also (ወ- 'and' + ዘ- 'that which' + enclitic -ኒ 'also, even')
glossary.ወዘንፉቅ: ንፉቅ — and which is cloven, split (ወ- 'and' + ዘ- relative + adjective)
glossary.ወዘአምሳሉ: አምሳል — and what is like it, 'after its kind' (ወ- 'and' + ዘ- 'what' + noun + -ሁ '3ms its')
glossary.ወዘአምሳሊሁ: አምሳል — and what is like it, 'after its kind' (ወ- 'and' + ዘ- 'what' + noun + -ሁ '3ms its')
glossary.ወዘኢትበልዑ: በልዐ — and which you do not eat (ወ- 'and' + ዘ- relative + ኢ- 'not' + 2mp imperfect, G, b-l-ʿ)
glossary.ወዘኢኮነ: ኮነ — and which is/was not (ወ- 'and' + ዘ- 'which' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, k-w-n)
glossary.ወዘይትመሰኳዕ: ተመሰኰዐ — and which chews the cud (ወ- + ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወዘገሰሰ: ገሰሰ — and whoever touched (ወ- 'and' + ዘ- 'who' + 3ms perfect, G, g-s-s)
glossary.ወዝራት: ዝራት — and zərat, name of an animal, perhaps the giraffe (Hebrew zemer) (ወ- 'and' + noun) (?)
glossary.ወዝንቱሰ: ዝንቱ — and this one indeed (ወ- + m. demonstrative + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወዝእብ: ዝእብ — and wolf, hyena (ወ- 'and' + noun); in this verse apparently an animal reckoned with the pig (?)
glossary.ወያብዝኅ: አብዝኀ — and may he multiply (ወ- 'and' + 3ms jussive, ʾa-stem causative of ብዝኀ)
glossary.ወይባርክ: ባረከ — and he will bless (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, b-r-k) · and may he bless (jussive, spelled like the imperfect; ወይባርክ ፍሬ ምድርክሙ 'and may he bless the fruit of your land')
glossary.ወይዕቀብ: ዐቀበ — and may he keep (ወ- 'and' + 3ms jussive, G, ʿ-q-b)
glossary.ወይጠል: ወይጠል — ibex, wild goat (noun; the initial ወ is part of the word, not 'and', since it is the first item after ዘእንበለ and the next two items carry their own ወ-) (?) · in the list ሀየል ወይጠል ቶራ here the ወ may be 'and' (ወ- + ይጠል), since the list joins its groups with ወ- (?)
glossary.ወደምሰስኪ: ደምሰሰ — and you destroyed (ወ- 'and' + 2fs perfect, quadriliteral)
glossary.ወዳሲጳዳ: ዳሲጳዳ — and the hare, a Greek word in Geʿez letters, perhaps from dasypous 'rough-foot' (ወ- 'and' + noun) (?)
glossary.ወጽፈሪሁ: ጽፍር — and his claw, hoof (ወ- 'and' + noun, stem ጽፈሪ- + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
glossary.ዓርጋ: ዓርጋ — name of an animal in the list, unidentified (noun) (?)
glossary.ዕለተ: ዕለት — day (noun, fem., construct state 'day-of') · also the accusative singular after a numeral (፯ ዕለተ 'seven days')
glossary.ዖርኪ: ዐወረ — you were blind (2fs perfect; ዖረ is the 3ms of this hollow verb; cf. አዖረ 'blinded', ch. 80)
glossary.ዘርኵስ: ርኵስ — of uncleanness (ዘ- 'of' + noun 'uncleanness'); predicate, 'these are of uncleanness'
glossary.ዘሰመየኪ: ሰመየ — who named you (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G + -ኪ '2fs you')
glossary.ዘቦ: ቦ — which has (ዘ- 'which' + ቦ 'there is to/with him, it')
glossary.ዘተዐደወ: ተዐደወ — who transgressed, departed (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, tä-stem of ዐደወ) · who surpassed (ዘተዐደወ እምጥበበ ሰብእ 'who surpassed the wisdom of men')
glossary.ዘተፈጥረ: ተፈጥረ — which was created (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, passive of ፈጠረ)
glossary.ዘትበልዑ: በልዐ — which you eat (ዘ- relative + 2mp imperfect, G, b-l-ʿ)
glossary.ዘትትመሐፀኑ: መሐፀነ — in which you entrust yourselves, take refuge (?) (ዘ- relative + 2mp imperfect, tä-stem) (?)
glossary.ዘነሥኦሙ: ነሥአ — that he took them (ዘ- + 3ms perfect + -ሙ '3mp them'); 'took them' or 'took from them' (?)
glossary.ዘንተኬ: ዝንቱ — this indeed (accusative ዘንተ + emphatic enclitic -ኬ)
glossary.ዘንፉቅ: ንፉቅ — which is cloven, split (ዘ- relative + adjective)
glossary.ዘአፍቀርኪያ: አፍቀረ — because you loved her (ዘ- 'that, what' + 2fs perfect + -ያ '3fs her'; after በእንተ)
glossary.ዘኢትበልዑ: በልዐ — which you do not eat (ዘ- relative + ኢ- 'not' + 2mp imperfect, G, b-l-ʿ)
glossary.ዘኢይሠምር: ሠምረ — what he is not pleased with (ዘ- 'what' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, G, ś-m-r)
glossary.ዘእምኀቤሁ: ኀበ — from whom (ዘ- 'who, which' + እም- 'from' + preposition, stem ኀቤ- + -ሁ '3ms him')
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
glossary.ዘከማኪ: ከማ — who is like you (ዘ- relative + preposition ከማ 'like' + -ኪ '2fs you')
glossary.ዘኮነ: ኮነ — that which was (ዘ- 'that which' + 3ms perfect, k-w-n)
glossary.ዘየሐትት: ሐተተ — who searches, examines (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, ḥ-t-t)
glossary.ዘይሰርር: ሰረረ — which flies (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect); root and sense from context (?) · or 'who speeds ahead' (?) · which creeps, moves along (?) (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect; ዘይሰርር በበ፪ 'which moves by twos', of swarming creatures)
glossary.ዘይበልዑ: በልዐ — that they eat (ዘ- + 3m pl imperfect, b-l-ʿ)
glossary.ዘይትመሰኳዕ: ተመሰኰዐ — which chews the cud (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ዘይትማሰለኪ: ተማሰለ — who resembles you (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem of መሰለ + -ኪ '2fs you')
glossary.ዘይትማሰላ: ተማሰለ — who resembles it (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, tä-ma stem of መሰለ + -ኣ '3fs it', ል + ኣ written ላ; anticipates ለኅሊናኪ 'your mind')
glossary.ዘጸልአ: ጸልአ — that which he hated (ዘ- 'what' + 3ms perfect, G, ṣ-l-ʾ)
glossary.ይረትዕ: ረትዐ — he is true, right (3ms imperfect, r-t-ʿ)
glossary.ይትመሰኵዑ: ተመሰኰዐ — they chew the cud (3mp imperfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ይኄይስ: ኀየሰ — he is better (3ms imperfect, G) · impersonal 'it is better' (ይኄይስ ዝየ ንብረት 'it is better to live here')
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ደቂቅክሙ: ደቂቅ — your sons (plural noun, plural of ወልድ + -ክሙ '2mp your')
glossary.ደገብያ: ደገብያ — name of a winged swarming creature, unidentified (noun) (?)
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ድስክነ: ድስክነ — name of an animal in the list, perhaps resembling Hebrew dishon (noun) (?)
glossary.ጊጳ: ጊጳ — name of an unclean bird, perhaps the vulture, from Greek gyps (noun) (?)
glossary.ግላውቃ: ግላውቃ — owl, a Greek word in Geʿez letters (glaux) (noun, name of a bird)
glossary.ግሪጳ: ግሪጳ — griffon vulture, a Greek word in Geʿez letters (gryps) (noun, name of a bird)
glossary.ጒዛ: ጒዛ — name of an unclean bird, unidentified (noun) (?)
glossary.ጒጓ: ጒጓ — name of an unclean bird, unidentified (noun) (?)
glossary.ጣዖቶሙ: ጣዖት — their idols (noun, collective singular + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ጥቅመ: ጥቅም — [ṭəqmä] (?) unidentified (noun, accusative or construct; uncertain) · here probably 'help, benefit' (ኩንነ ጥቅመ 'be a help to us') (?)
glossary.ጥበብሰ: ጥበብ — wisdom, as for her (noun, fem. + contrastive -ሰ) · 'as for wisdom' (ጥበብ + the topic-marking -ሰ: ጥበብሰ ወልቡና እምኔኪ ሠረጸት)
glossary.ጳርፋርዮና: ጳርፋርዮና — purple gallinule, a Greek word in Geʿez letters (porphyrion) (noun, name of a bird) (?)
glossary.ጸህቂያ: ጸሐቀ — you delighted in her (?) (2fs perfect + -ያ '3fs her'; the verb means laugh, play, rejoice; written with ህ for ሐ as in ch. 37, and with ቅ + ኪ run together, for ጸሐቅኪያ (?)) (?)
glossary.ጸመምኪ: ጸመመ — you were deaf (2fs perfect, G, ṣ-m-m; ጸመመ 'be deaf' in ch. 54)
glossary.ጸመውኪ: ጸመወ — you fasted (2fs perfect, G, ṣ-m-w)
glossary.ጸማእኪ: ጸምአ — you thirsted (2fs perfect, G, ṣ-m-ʾ)
glossary.ጽግነት: ጽግነት — unknown word, some flying creature; meaning from context (?)
glossary.ጽፈሪሆሙ: ጽፍር — their claws, hooves (noun, stem ጽፈሪ- + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ፈሪሀ: ፈሪህ — fear of (noun; construct ፈሪሀ in ፈሪሀ እግዚኣብሔር 'fear of God', as ወፈሪሀ in ch. 27; related to ፍርሀት)
glossary.ፈቀድኪ: ፈቀደ — you wished (2fs perfect, G, f-q-d)
glossary.ፈድፈደ: ፈድፈደ — he exceeds, surpasses (3ms perfect, quadriliteral, f-d-f-d)
glossary.ፍርሀተ: ፍርሀት — fear (construct 'fear of') · also accusative, object: ያአትት ፍርሀተ 'he removes fear'
glossary.፺፩: ፺፩ — 91, spoken ተስዓ ወአሐዱ (täsʿa wä-ʾäḥädu) 'ninety-one'; chapter number (numeral)
